limitation: Four deliberately selected cases, not a random or full solver-replay audit. Cached action replay uses the observed problem; separate deterministic feasibility recheck uses post-decision evaluator true_problem with comparison lineage aligned as in production evaluator. Simulator physical fulfillment clamps infeasible transfer quantities, so violations describe committed plans rather than negative physical stock.
